summary: Felucca [Salt], a fork of the Felucca multi-engine synth that adds TRS MIDI input, external clock and display options, plus a browser Studio that can edit the FM-1 or play a synth on its own. Still a beta.
features: Nine engines incl. virtual analog, 4-op FM, organ, formant voice and granular
Three synth tracks and a GM drum track; 8 voices shared
64-step sequencer with chords, ties, accent, slide and live overdub
Clock from internal, USB or TRS, with Start, Stop and Continue
Scale keyboard mode, preset favourites, twenty screen palettes
The hosted Studio and installer send analytics by default; can be turned off
